uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2034-5220-6961-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
1270-2034-5220-6961-8347.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Sela triggers, creating three creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

3693-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Walking Ballista is in your graveyard.
3693-5006-8170.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Walking Ballista. It enters as dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat.

222-527-7175-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-7175-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2692-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
2692-7084-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Felidar Retreat triggers, either putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control and granting them vigilance until end of turn or creating a 2/2 white Cat Beast creature token
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1669-4875-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
1669-4875-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability, giving Thaumatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

4060-4881-6909-8198.manaNeeded: {6}{B}{R}{G} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4060-4881-6909-8198.description:
Cast Volatile Claws by paying {2}{R}, causing creatures you control to get +2/+0 and gain all creature types until end of turn.
Cast Trystan's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 4, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 6

1339-2425-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2425-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Smothering Abomination triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

687-4050-4613-8130-8135.description:
Cast Vizier of the Scorpion by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Vizier of the Scorpion enters, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Army token.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Vizier of the Scorpion and the creature token, adding two mana.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Vizier of the Scorpion from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-4050-4613-8130-8135.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

147-728-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7825.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bifur.
When Bifur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Bifur enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
5256-6972-7825.notes: If you have an enduring story, Bifur will trigger twice, and the other counter can be placed on whatever creature you desire.

3330-4399-4770-5998.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Leyline of Vitality trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Leyline of Vitality trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3330-4399-4770-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

997-6553-7424.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

206-3372-4050-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
206-3372-4050-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

2525-3358-4460.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

176-5686-6705.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-5686-6705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
176-5686-6705.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Quina.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood artifact token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

527-1409-6633.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

141-3967-6817.description:
Cast Presumed Dead by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Presumed Dead, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Presumed Dead.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities from step 5.

1987-4423-5034-6918.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sol Ring by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sol Ring.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

751-2639-3254-4050.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
751-2639-3254-4050.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Shrieking Drake and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Shrieking Drake and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
751-2639-3254-4050.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

460-539-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Selvala.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

703-4663-6441.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Bramble Sovereign trigger.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Elspeth, Storm Slayer that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Bramble Sovereign trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens.
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating an extremely large number of Elspeth, Storm Slayer tokens that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
703-4663-6441.notes: You can activate the second abilities of the Elspeth tokens, if desired, to get near-infinite +1/+1 counters

488-1492-2895-4708-4986.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of either Dark Sphere or Welding Jar must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-1492-2895-4708-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1491-3755-4029-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-3755-4029-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-3755-4029-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

5413-5478-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Archelos is untapped.
5413-5478-5531-5732.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.

1495-4613-5616.notablePrerequisites: Strong has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-4613-5616.description:
Activate Strong using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to Strong.
Strong triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to get three rad counters.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Strong using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 4 as desired.
1495-4613-5616.notes: This combo typically wins with infinite damage, but if the game isn't over by your next precombat main phase, your rad counters will trigger, causing you to mill any number of cards and gain a large amount of life (or lose that amount if Strong has left the battlefield).

1496-2034-3263-4078-4242.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1496-2034-3263-4078-4242.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

2665-2743-3129.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating two token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

339-2011-4804.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
339-2011-4804.description:
Declare Najeela and Beacon Hawk as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Najeela and Beacon Hawk.
Beacon Hawk triggers, untapping Jegantha.
Repeat each combat phase.

2198-2556-3647-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and Deceiver Exarch.
Mnemonic Wall and Deceiver Exarch enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deceiver Exarch trigger, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

224-5033-5196.notablePrerequisites:
You have a basic land in hand.
Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
224-5033-5196.description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's first ability by tapping it, putting a basic land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the basic land from your battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

225-539-1671-2248.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Skyshroud Ranger as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.
